message.content:
This editorial illustration features a magazine cover with various textual and graphic elements. At the top, "TEMPO" is printed in large, dark serif letters above the tagline "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU". Above this, smaller text reads "PEMBUBARAN IBADAH NATAL" and "PELAJARAN DARI GEMPA PIDIE JAYA". 

The central image displays a line of four light-brown cardboard tanks moving diagonally from the right towards the left. Each tank is constructed from folded and taped cardboard boxes, complete with a rectangular body, a turret, and a protruding cardboard tube for a cannon. Inside each turret, a different person's head and shoulders are visible, facing forward. On the left, a man in a white long-sleeved shirt and dark trousers stands with his back to the viewer, holding a striped traffic cone on the ground. 

Large white text above the tanks reads "MAKAR", followed by a smaller paragraph beginning with "POLISI MEMATAHKAN RENCANA...". In the bottom-right corner, there is a date "12-18 DESEMBER 2016", a price "RP 45.000", a barcode, and a website address. The background is a flat, textured gray surface.
